name: [NEW] Mafia Boss
desc:
Lead an organization, conquer turfs to gain cash or you become police and stop the crimes. Strategize, dominate, and rise to power in this thrilling turf war! 

Team up, roleplay, discover secrets and lores. Will the mafia prevail in this modern world?

Gain cash by:
- Collect cash from ATMs, banks and small stores.
- Conquer turfs
- [COPS] Arresting criminals

Join/subscribe social links for code.
